title: ardisia standleyi
intro: Ardisia standleyi, commonly known as the Guayacan plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrsinaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The plant is known to possess several health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of reducing fever, alleviating cough, and treating respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Ardisia standleyi include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
